不知道炉型，也可以先提供工件信息: You can start with the workpiece even if you have not chosen a furnace.
工件材质、尺寸、重量，以及每炉装多少、每小时要处理多少。: State the material, dimensions, piece weight, batch load and required hourly output.
常用与最高温度、升温保温降温曲线，以及温度均匀性要求。: Give operating and maximum temperatures, heating, soaking and cooling cycles, and temperature uniformity.
现场与交付怎么安排: What are the site and delivery conditions?
能源条件、车间空间、装卸方式，以及交期和安装调试范围。: Identify the energy supply, floor space, loading method, delivery date, installation and commissioning scope.
资料不全可以先判断方向，再补充关键参数。正式报价以确认后的技术方案、配置清单和交: A preliminary discussion can start with partial data. A firm quotation follows the agreed design, equipment list and scope of delivery.
报价前，逐项核对这 11 个参数: 11 parameters to check before requesting a price
按工件、工艺和现场分组整理；暂时不确定的内容，可先标注待确认。: Group the details by workpiece, process and site. Mark any outstanding item “to be confirmed.”
材质、单件尺寸、单件重量、装夹方式、最大外形尺寸。: Material, individual and maximum overall dimensions, piece weight and fixturing.
长、宽、高或有效工作区尺寸，决定炉体结构和装料空间。: Length, width and height of the usable working zone determine structure and loading space.
每炉装多少、每天处理多少、连续炉每小时产能或线速度。: State the batch weight, daily target, or hourly throughput and line speed for a continuous furnace.
设计最高温度和常用工作温度，例如 650℃、950℃、1200℃ 等。: Specify the maximum design and usual operating temperatures, for example 650°C, 950°C or 1200°C.
退火、固溶、时效、回火、淬火、正火等；最好提供升温、保温、降温曲线。: Annealing, solution treatment, ageing, tempering, quenching or normalizing. Include a temperature–time curve if available.
是否要求 ±5℃、±10℃、±15℃ 等，具体需结合炉型和工艺判断。: State whether ±5°C, ±10°C, ±15°C or another tolerance is required for the process and furnace.
电、天然气、液化气、柴油、钢厂副产气等。: Electricity, natural gas, LPG, diesel or steelworks by-product gas.
普通温控、PLC、触摸屏、记录仪、数据追溯、MES/SCADA 对接等。: Temperature controllers, PLC, touch panel, recorder, traceability or connections to plant MES/SCADA systems.
台车炉、箱式炉、井式炉、网带炉、辊底炉、推杆炉等；如果不确定，可描述工件和工艺，: Car-bottom, box, pit, mesh-belt, roller-hearth or pusher furnace. If undecided, describe the part and process.
车间空间、电源、气源、吊装条件、基础条件、进出料方式。: Floor space, electricity, gas, lifting equipment, foundations and charging or discharge method.
交期、安装调试、是否需要改造旧炉、是否涉及搬迁复产。: Target delivery, installation and commissioning, existing-furnace alterations, relocation or restart.
有工件照片、图纸或温度曲线，可在技术沟通时一并补充。: Include photos, drawings or process curves when available.
不同炉型，还要重点补充什么？: What else does each furnace type require?
在通用参数之外，按计划采购或改造的炉型核对重点。: Check the following points in addition to the common parameters.
了解旧炉改造的处理方向: Review options for an existing furnace
比较报价，先看供货范围是否一致: Compare quotations against the same scope of supply
同样叫“台车炉”或“退火炉”，配置和工程量也可能不同。新炉及改造项目，都应明确哪: Car-bottom and annealing furnaces can differ substantially in configuration and quantities. For new and retrofit projects, identify included work and items requiring separate confirmation.
诊断、方案设计、工程量清单、设备与系统配置、图纸及技术文件。: Diagnosis, design, quantities, equipment and system configuration, drawings and technical documentation.
现场测绘、第三方设计或专项认证是否包含，需在报价中单列。: Itemize site surveys, third-party design and special certification.
炉体、炉衬、热源或燃烧系统、机械传动、控制系统、安全联锁及约定附件。: Shell, lining, heat source or combustion system, mechanical drives, controls, safety interlocks and agreed accessories.
保留旧件、客户自备件、易损件和备品备件范围需逐项确认。: Identify retained components, buyer-supplied items, consumables and spares.
按约定范围拆除、制造、运输、安装、调试和操作培训。: Dismantling, manufacture, transport, installation, commissioning and operator training within the agreed scope.
基础、吊装、水电气接入、脚手架、保温拆除恢复及停产配合由谁承担，必须写清。: Assign foundations, lifting, utilities, scaffolding, removal and reinstatement of insulation, and shutdown support.
合同约定的出厂检查、现场调试、性能测试和资料交付。: Agreed factory inspections, commissioning, performance tests and documents.
第三方检测、排放检测、认证测试及额外复测通常需按项目单独确认。: Confirm third-party inspection, emissions testing, certification tests and additional retesting separately.
有效工作区越大，炉体钢结构、炉衬材料、加热功率和制造工时都会变化，不能只按炉型名: A larger working zone changes steelwork, lining, heating power and fabrication hours. The furnace name alone gives no cost basis.
650℃、950℃、1200℃ 等温度等级对应的耐材、加热元件、测温和控制配置不: 650°C, 950°C and 1200°C classes call for different refractories, heating elements, instruments and controls.
单炉装料重量、台车承重、料筐或输送结构会影响炉体强度、传动方式和安全余量。: Batch weight, car rating, baskets or conveyors affect strength, drive selection and margin.
退火、回火、正火、固溶等工艺对温区、风循环、升温曲线和保温控制的要求不同。: Annealing, tempering, normalizing and solution treatment impose different requirements for zoning, circulation, heating and soaking.
电加热、天然气、液化气、柴油或钢厂副产气涉及不同的热源系统、管路和安全联锁配置。: Electricity, natural gas, LPG, diesel and by-product gas each require different heating systems, pipework and interlocks.
普通温控、PLC、触摸屏、记录仪、数据追溯和产线联动会带来不同的电控系统成本。: Controllers, PLCs, touch panels, recorders, traceability and line integration change electrical and controls costs.
在温度、材料和供货范围等条件可比时，工作区扩大通常增加材料和制造投入；具体成本还: At comparable temperature, materials and scope, larger working zones generally require more material and fabrication. Verify the specific design.
温度越高，耐材和加热系统要求越高。: Higher temperatures increase demands on refractories and heating systems.
装炉量越大，结构强度要求越高。: Heavier charges require greater structural strength.
温度均匀性要求应结合加热、传热、装载、测温和控制方案核对；采用强制对流的炉型，再: Check uniformity against heating, heat transfer, loading, sensors and controls. For forced convection, also check fans and flow guides.
在功能、品牌、接口和供货范围可比时，新增自动化功能通常增加电控配置与实施投入；不: With comparable functions, brands, interfaces and scope, additional automation generally increases controls and implementation costs. Compare the actual scope.
燃气炉比普通电阻炉多燃烧系统、管路和安全联锁。: Gas-fired furnaces add combustion equipment, pipework and interlocks compared with basic electric resistance furnaces.
连续炉比周期炉更依赖输送、温区和节拍设计。: Continuous furnaces depend more on conveying, zoning and cycle coordination than batch furnaces.
改造项目需要结合旧炉状态判断，不能只按新炉价格估算。: Estimate a retrofit against the condition of the existing furnace.
以下为具体项目参数参考，包含旧炉改造与产线级项目，用于说明报价变量；不代表单台炉: These project figures illustrate retrofit and line-level pricing inputs. Each set belongs to its own project and does not establish standard equipment, prices or throughput elsewhere.
超大型燃气台车退火炉改造: Large gas-fired car-bottom annealing furnace retrofit
有效加热区约 13 × 7.4 × 4.3 m，额定/最高使用温度 700℃；方: Working zone approximately 13 × 7.4 × 4.3 m. Rated/maximum operating temperature 700°C. The design uses 14 control zones and fourteen 630 kW-class high-velocity natural gas burners (14 × 630 kW = 8,820 kW). Combustion air at 250–300°C was a design target.
需要同时核算炉体结构、炉衬、燃烧系统、管路、安全联锁、排烟与现场施工边界。: Allow for the structure, lining, combustion, piping, safety interlocks, exhaust and site responsibilities.
850 mm 连续退火钝化线退火固溶段: Annealing and solution-treatment section of an 850 mm strip line
项目退火温度约 1050–1150℃，炉温最高可至 1300℃，退火炉主体长度约: Strip annealing temperature approximately 1050–1150°C, maximum furnace temperature up to 1300°C, and furnace body approximately 130 m long.
除炉体外，还要确认带材规格、速度核算、温区、冷却、收放卷和自动化接口。: Confirm strip dimensions, speed calculations, temperature zones, cooling, recoiling and controls interfaces.
淬火炉工作尺寸约 400 × 3200 mm，回火炉约 400 × 5600 m: Working dimensions approximately 400 × 3200 mm for quenching and 400 × 5600 mm for tempering. The quoted 950°C rating applies to the quench furnace. Approximately 150 kg/h is a design reference for the specified loading conditions.
报价需覆盖连续输送、气氛、淬火、清洗、回火、速度和产能边界，不能按单台炉估算。: Include conveying, atmosphere, quenching, washing, tempering, speed and throughput conditions in the quotation.

按已有信息填写，暂时不清楚的项目写“待确认”即可，再通过官网表单、电话或微信、邮: Fill in what you know and mark unknowns “to be confirmed.” Send via the website form, phone, WeChat or email.

资料提交后，报价如何推进？: What happens after you send the information?
先判断方案方向，再确认关键参数，最后形成可核对的正式报价。: Review the design direction, confirm the key parameters and prepare a checkable quotation.
先提供炉型、工件、温度、产能、工艺和现场条件等基础信息。: Provide furnace type, workpiece, temperatures, throughput, process and site conditions.
技术人员根据参数判断适合新炉定制、旧炉改造还是大修升级。: An engineer assesses a new design, retrofit or overhaul against the supplied information.
对炉膛尺寸、装炉量、控温要求、能源条件和交付边界做二次确认。: Recheck chamber dimensions, loading, temperature controls, utilities and delivery boundaries.
输出初步技术方案和报价范围: Receive an initial proposal and price range
在资料清楚的前提下，给出方案方向、主要配置和报价范围。: Once the data are clear, Suneng can outline the design, equipment and price range.
形成正式报价和技术方案: Confirm the formal proposal and price
双方确认细节后，再输出正式报价、技术方案和交付范围。: The final technical proposal, quotation and scope follow agreement on the details.
通常 1 个工作日内进行初步判断；具体回复时间以项目复杂度和资料完整度为准。资料: An initial assessment generally takes one working day. Response and quotation timing depend on complexity, the information available and the site. Existing furnaces or complex lines may require a survey.
